education_requirements: Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
common_responsibilities: Collaborate with design and product teams
trends: Strong demand for full-stack and specialized roles (Backend, Frontend, DevOps).
Prevalence of cloud platforms (AWS) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Emphasis on modern JavaScript frameworks (React, TypeScript) for frontend and full-stack roles.
Python remains a highly sought-after language across various roles.
Agile methodologies and Git are standard requirements.
Hybrid and remote work models are common, alongside onsite roles.
Entry to Mid-level positions are frequently available, suggesting a need for developing talent.
industry_expectations: Candidates are expected to have a Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Proficiency in version control (Git) is mandatory.
Experience with cloud services (AWS) and containerization (Docker) is highly valued.
Ability to work in agile environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills are essential.
Focus on writing clean, scalable, and testable code.
Understanding of system design and performance optimization.
